title: OFFLINE CAMP CONFESSION
description: When players return, camps now explain every decay tick, raider visit, spoiled stew, and suspiciously missing plank in a plain log signed by the system itself.
consequence: The camp leaves a signed confession.

title: VACATION STREAK RECEIPT
description: Daily streaks now show exactly what pauses, what expires, and what waits politely while the player is away, including a little calendar stamp labeled "go live outside."
consequence: The streak timer learns paid leave.

title: LIVE GARAGE PROGRESS
description: Car upgrades now send workshop photos, mechanic notes, dyno whispers, and shifting completion estimates as the crew tunes each part through a more detailed build process.
consequence: The garage keeps sending postcards from almost done.

title: FAIRNESS LOGIN SEARCH
description: Every new run now begins with deck integrity checks, shuffle verification, anti-cheat seals, and a solemn reminder that honest players have nothing to worry about.
consequence: The login screen pats everyone down for dice.
